sources.title: schollz/croc - Easily transfer files and folders from one computer to another
sources.summary: Go-based file transfer tool, 37.7K stars, MIT. PAKE encryption, self-hostable relay, resumable transfers, cross-platform. CLI tool with Go library API.

sources.title: Croc Documentation - Installation and Usage
sources.summary: Full usage docs: send/receive, relay modes, custom codes, text transfer, resume support, proxy/Tor, self-hosted relay setup.

sources.title: Self-hosting Croc relay
sources.summary: Self-host relay with Docker or Go binary. Relay listens on ports 9009-9013. Custom relay address via --relay flag.

sources.title: Croc as Go library (exported methods)
sources.summary: Go package exposes croc.Send and croc.Receive functions. Can embed croc as library in Go programs. Not directly callable from TypeScript/Bun.

sources.title: JSON output mode (requested feature)
sources.summary: JSON output mode has been requested but not implemented. CLI wrapper approach must parse stdout text output instead.

sources.title: Croc security model - PAKE encryption
sources.summary: Uses PAKE (Password-Authenticated Key Exchange) for E2E encryption. Relay never sees plaintext. Code is derived from password via SRP-like protocol.

sources.title: Croc architecture - How it works
sources.summary: Core transfer logic: PAKE handshake, TCP relay for control/data, direct TCP connection for file transfer when possible. IPv6-first with IPv4 fallback.

sources.title: Magic Wormhole vs Croc comparison
sources.summary: Magic Wormhole: Python-based, WAMP protocol, requires transit server. Croc: Go-based, PAKE, self-hostable relay, faster for large files.

sources.title: Croc Docker deployment
sources.summary: Official Docker image for self-hosted relay. Simple docker run command with port mapping for 9009-9013.

sources.title: Bun child_process for CLI wrapper pattern
sources.summary: Bun's child_process.spawn can invoke external CLI tools. Compatible with Croc CLI wrapper approach for TypeScript integration.

key_findings.architecture: PAKE-based E2E encryption over TCP relay. 9-character code as password. Self-hostable relay on ports 9009-9013.
key_findings.api_surface: CLI-first with Go library (croc.Send/croc.Receive). No native TypeScript/Bun API. JSON output not yet implemented.
integration_options: CLI wrapper via Bun child_process (simplest, recommended)
Go library embedding via bun-go FFI (most native, complex)
Self-hosted relay as backend service (cleanest architecture)
key_findings.security: PAKE encryption, relay never sees plaintext, E2E encrypted. No auth required for relay. Rate limiting via IP.
key_findings.performance: Resumable transfers, direct TCP when possible, IPv6-first. Handles large files. Multiple file/directory support.
